{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Charicific Valley |characters=リザフィックバレー |japanese=Lizafic Valley |image=Charicific Valley main area.png |imagesize=250px |region=Johto |epicode=EP134 |episode=Charizard's Burning Ambitions }} The '''Charicific Valley Natural Reserve''', better known as simply the '''Charicific Valley''' (Japanese: '''リザフィックバレー''' ''Lizafic Valley''), is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Johto]]. It is located between [[Violet City]] and [[Azalea Town]]. The Charicific Valley is a place where many {{p|Charizard}} live. In the Japanese version, they are referred to as the guardian deities of the area, while in the [[dub]], the Charizard are simply training in the valley to grow stronger. It is distinguishable by its rock formation in the shape of a giant Charizard. The only known human who lives in the valley is {{jo|Liza}}, who, along with her Charizard, [[Charla]], protects the valley from danger. {{Ash}} left his {{AP|Charizard}} here to train when he was heading through the Johto [[region]]. Noticing how much his Charizard enjoyed spending time in the valley, and noticing that he was one of the weaker Charizard there, Ash decided to leave him in the valley so he could train. Since Charizard was left here to train, he became very powerful, learning many new attacks, including {{m|Dragon Breath}}, {{m|Overheat}}, {{m|Steel Wing}}, {{m|Wing Attack}}, {{m|Slash}}, and {{m|Dragon Tail}}. He also formed a relationship with Charla. In ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]'', Charizard saw a [[television]] broadcast watched by Liza, depicting {{Delia|Ash's mother}} being kidnapped in [[Greenfield]]. Seeing his Trainer in trouble, Charizard departed to help him. The valley was seen in a flashback in ''[[BW116|The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!]]'', when Ash recalled how he left Charizard. Following Charizard's travels with Ash in [[Unova]], he decided to stay at [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] instead of returning to Charicific Valley. {{-}} ==Pokémon seen in Charicific Valley== {| style="margin:auto; width: 100%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Liza|Charla|Liza Charla.png|Fire|Flying|nick=Charla}} ♀ | {{ActivePoké|Charicific Valley|Charizard|Giant Charizard.png|Fire|Flying|disp=Charizard (multiple)|link=no}} | |} ===Pokémon formerly seen in Charicific Valley=== {| style="margin:auto; width: 100%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Ash|Charizard|Liza Ash Charizard.png|Fire|Flying|nick=Ash's Charizard}} ♂ | |} ==Gallery== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #c46c65; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #B23D33" |- style="background:#D89D98" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | Charicific Valley ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | Inside Charicific Valley ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | Liza's home |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Charicific Valley.png|x150px]] | [[File:Inside Charicific Valley.png|x150px]] | [[File:Charific Valley Liza Home.png|x150px]] |} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_yue=噴火龍山谷 |zh_cmn=噴火龍山谷 / 喷火龙山谷 ''Pēnhuǒlóng Shāngǔ'' |da=Charicific-dalen |nl=Charicific Valley |fi=Charis-laakso{{tt|*|EP134}}
